periods.label: 激励一辉的前七星剑王

status.current: helps Ikki prepare and celebrates his victory
status.condition: healthy enough to spar lightly, withholding lethal Tiger Bite

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former first-round opponent; treats Ikki as a worthy successor and demands he enter the final with certain victory.
relationships.toka-todo: Fellow top helper in Ikki's tuning gauntlet.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Bukyou teammate present for the gauntlet and final.

periods.summary: Moroboshi brings additional former opponents to Ikki's training ring and acts as the final helper before Ouma. He tests Ikki with spear pressure, reveals he had withheld the full speed of Sanrensei in their tournament bout, and forces Ikki to rely on pure central breakthrough rather than tricks. After losing the spar, he tells Ikki that he must not take half-hearted confidence into the final and offers to continue until Ikki finds it. He later cheers Ikki's championship victory with childlike excitement.

key_events.summary: Pushes Ikki through a spear duel and gives him the advice to believe one hundred percent in victory.
Congratulates Ikki as a defeated rival whose title has been inherited.

periods.time: Ikki's victory party at Ittousei after Seven Stars
periods.label: 挑战斗神联盟的决定
periods.affiliation: Ittousei Academy; Moroboshi family restaurant Ittousei

status.current: chooses to pursue the brutal Chinese Toushin League rather than Japan's domestic league
status.condition: motivated by Koume's recovered voice and his loss to Ikki

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend and former opponent whose victory he celebrates.
relationships.toka-todo: Friendly rival; they discuss the match they never had and future pro paths.
relationships.koume-moroboshi: Younger sister whose regained cheer renews his drive.

periods.summary: Moroboshi hosts Ikki's victory party at his family restaurant and cooks for the guests with Koume. He later talks privately with Toka about her anti-Hahakiboshi technique and the match they never got to have. Inspired by Koume's recovered voice and aware that his body techniques still lag behind Ikki, he decides not to enter Japan's domestic league after graduation. Instead, he plans to challenge China's brutal Toushin League to find the death-edge experience needed to grow, with the eventual aim of reaching the A-League.

key_events.summary: Hosts the party and declares his plan to challenge the Toushin League.

periods.time: After Seven Stars, before leaving for Toujin Cup preliminaries
periods.label: 败给剑士杀手的浪速之星

status.current: preparing to travel to China early for the Toujin Cup survival preliminaries
status.condition: loses a hard spar to Kuraudo while revealing new blind-spot spear techniques

relationships.koume-moroboshi: Younger sister; reported to be lively and talkative after recovering her speech.
relationships.toka-todo: Old rival; his previous victory over her remains a motivation for Toka.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Sparring opponent; Moroboshi loses but leaves Kuraudo frightened by an unfinished final move.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Classmate and rival who considers Moroboshi more frightening than Ikki due to his instinctive counters.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Toujin Cup veteran whom Moroboshi hoped to consult before leaving Japan.

periods.summary: Moroboshi comes to the League Japan Branch partly for special conscription pay and partly hoping to ask Nango about the Toujin Cup, only to find Nango abroad searching for the missing prime minister. Planning to leave for China a month early, he challenges Kuraudo after noticing Kuraudo's growth. In the spar, he demonstrates the depth of his range control, Tiger King, Tiger Bite, Hahakiboshi and a newly developed Blind-Spot Thrust that attacks the physiological blind spot. He gradually converts defense into offense and corners Kuraudo, but Kuraudo's violent intuition and short-blade Yamatano Orochi overwhelm him. Moroboshi loses, though his final Unrivaled Single Stroke hints at a still-dangerous secret tied to the presence he sensed near death against Ikki.

key_events.summary: Challenges Kuraudo, nearly overturns bad matchup with blind-spot thrusts, but loses.
Is discussed by Toka as a rival she still wants to surpass before he leaves for the Toujin Cup.

periods.time: Emergency summons from Bukyoku to Kyushu
periods.label: 第一与第二支箭
periods.affiliation: Bukyoku Academy; International Mage-Knight League emergency response

status.current: survives Daien's defeat, exhausted but praised by Itsuki Kurogane as a future commander-type talent
status.condition: physically drained after carrying the fight, using Tiger Bite on Kuraudo's Device, and killing Tendo's soul

relationships.toka-todo: Saves her from the graveyard, trusts her as the third arrow, and stops her from overexerting herself afterward.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Calls him from Tokyo and enchants Orochimaru with Tiger Bite despite their hostile banter.
relationships.harima-tendo: Primary anti-Daien combatant; can harm him through Tiger Bite and kills his soul with Musou Ittetsu.
relationships.byakuya-jounosaki: Brought to Kyushu by Jounosaki's teleportation during the emergency summons.
relationships.utakata-misogi: Coordinates with him to reach Toka, then credits Misogi's result manipulation for saving them from the landslide.

periods.summary: Moroboshi is specially summoned by Itsuki Kurogane because Tiger Bite can destroy magic and therefore affect Tendo's spirit body. He teleports from Osaka to Fukuoka with Jounosaki, saves Misogi and Toka from Tendo's fire, and immediately recognizes that solo victory is impossible. After Tokyo is attacked and Kurono is recalled, Moroboshi secretly expands the available options by calling Kuraudo Kurashiki to Kyushu. He enchants Kuraudo's Orochimaru with Tiger Bite to create Gluttonous Serpent, lets Kuraudo occupy Tendo, then pierces Tendo from behind with Musou Ittetsu, devouring Tendo's soul and ending his living body. When Tendo persists as a storm-remnant, Moroboshi refuses the solitary-hero trial and entrusts the finish to Toka and the people of Kyushu.

key_events.summary: Blocks Tendo's fire, shields Toka and Misogi, then retreats after judging Daien too strong.
Helps create the three-arrow plan by identifying Kuraudo as the needed second arrow.
Adds Tiger Bite to Kuraudo's Orochimaru and later kills Tendo's soul with Musou Ittetsu.
Rejects Tendo's final demand that he awaken alone and points to Toka as the third arrow.

periods.time: EDY breach of Tokyo's underground defense layer
periods.label: 浪速之星支援地下防卫

status.current: helps repel the EDY invasion of the underground city

relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Returns with him and initiates the EDY cleanup despite Kuraudo's irritation.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Apologizes for dragging Kuraudo away and helps rescue her defense line.

periods.summary: Moroboshi arrives in the underground defense layer with Kuraudo after the low-rank student defense has been pushed to the final floor. He apologizes to Ayase for pulling Kuraudo away and demonstrates that, even though his Noble Art is ineffective against machines, his spear skill alone can pierce EDY armor and cores. Together with Kuraudo and the returning western Japan knights, he helps destroy the EDY units threatening the underground city.

key_events.summary: Pierces EDY armor with Tiger King and leads cleanup with Kuraudo.
